package practiceroute

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/pedagogy"
)

var (
	targetDOM = domain.TargetRef{Type: domain.TargetCapability, Key: "javascript.dom-events", Version: "v1"}
	targetCSS = domain.TargetRef{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "css.grid", Version: "v1"}
)

func TestResolveFreezesCompetencyFirstDecisionsAndMaterialIdentities(t *testing.T) {
	routes := newRouteRepositoryStub()
	catalog := &practiceCatalogStub{definitions: []domain.LearningTargetDefinition{
		{Ref: targetDOM, Title: "DOM events", Description: "Handle browser events"},
		{Ref: targetCSS, Title: "CSS Grid", Description: "Build grid layouts"},
	}}
	students := &practiceStudentStub{mastery: []domain.TargetMastery{
		{Target: targetDOM, State: domain.MasteryMastered, MasteryScore: .91, Confidence: .88, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion},
		{Target: targetCSS, State: domain.MasteryUnknown, MasteryScore: 0, Confidence: 0, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion},
	}}
	resolver := testResolver(routes, catalog, students)
	request := validRouteRequest()
	route, created, err := resolver.Resolve(context.Background(), request.TaskInstanceID, request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve: %v", err)
	}
	if !created || route.Schema != domain.PracticeLearningRouteSchemaV1 || route.RouteDigest == "" || len(route.Steps) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("route=%+v created=%v", route, created)
	}
	requirements := route.Steps[0].Requirements
	if requirements[0].Decision != domain.RequirementSatisfied || requirements[0].Blocking || requirements[0].Material != nil {
		t.Fatalf("mastered required target was not satisfied: %+v", requirements[0])
	}
	if requirements[1].Decision != domain.RequirementChallengeOrLearn || !requirements[1].Blocking ||
		!requirements[1].ChallengeOutAllowed || requirements[1].Material == nil || requirements[1].Material.GenerationKey == "" {
		t.Fatalf("adaptive target did not produce challenge-or-learn route: %+v", requirements[1])
	}
	if requirements[2].Decision != domain.RequirementRecommend || requirements[2].Blocking || requirements[2].Material == nil {
		t.Fatalf("recommended target has wrong semantics: %+v", requirements[2])
	}

	replayed, created, err := resolver.Resolve(context.Background(), request.TaskInstanceID, request)
	if err != nil || created || replayed.RouteDigest != route.RouteDigest || students.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("replay changed frozen route: route=%+v created=%v mastery_calls=%d err=%v", replayed, created, students.calls, err)
	}
}

func TestResolveFailsClosedWhenCatalogDoesNotOwnEveryTarget(t *testing.T) {
	resolver := testResolver(newRouteRepositoryStub(), &practiceCatalogStub{definitions: []domain.LearningTargetDefinition{{Ref: targetDOM, Title: "DOM", Description: "Events"}}}, &practiceStudentStub{})
	_, _, err := resolver.Resolve(context.Background(), validRouteRequest().TaskInstanceID, validRouteRequest())
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("expected missing target, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestReconcileReadinessUsesCurrentStudentMasteryAndReturnsIdempotentReceipt(t *testing.T) {
	routes := newRouteRepositoryStub()
	catalog := &practiceCatalogStub{definitions: []domain.LearningTargetDefinition{{Ref: targetDOM, Title: "DOM events", Description: "Handle browser events"}}}
	students := &practiceStudentStub{mastery: []domain.TargetMastery{{Target: targetDOM, State: domain.MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}}}
	readiness := newReadinessRepositoryStub()
	resolver := testResolver(routes, catalog, students)
	resolver.Readiness = readiness
	input := readinessRouteRequest()

	route, _, err := resolver.Resolve(context.Background(), input.TaskInstanceID, domain.PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1{
		Schema: domain.PracticeLearningRouteRequestSchemaV1, StudentID: input.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: input.TaskInstanceID,
		TaskRevisionID: input.TaskRevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: input.TaskRevisionDigest, Locale: "ru",
		Steps: []domain.PracticeLearningStepInput{{StepID: input.StepID, Requirements: []domain.PracticeLearningRequirement{{
			ID: "required-dom", Target: targetDOM, Policy: domain.RequirementPolicyRequired, MasteryThreshold: .7,
		}}}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	input.RouteID, input.RouteDigest = route.ID, route.RouteDigest

	first, created, err := resolver.ReconcileReadiness(context.Background(), "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", input)
	if err != nil || !created || first.Decision != domain.PracticeReadinessNotReady {
		t.Fatalf("initial reconciliation = (%+v, created=%v, err=%v), want persisted NOT_READY", first, created, err)
	}
	students.mastery = []domain.TargetMastery{{Target: targetDOM, State: domain.MasteryMastered, MasteryScore: .91, Confidence: .92, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}}
	replay, created, err := resolver.ReconcileReadiness(context.Background(), "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", input)
	if err != nil || created || replay.ID != first.ID || replay.Decision != domain.PracticeReadinessNotReady || students.calls != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("same-key replay = (%+v, created=%v, calls=%d, err=%v), want original receipt", replay, created, students.calls, err)
	}
	changed := input
	changed.RouteDigest = "sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd"
	if _, _, err := resolver.ReconcileReadiness(context.Background(), "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", changed); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("same key with changed payload = %v, want conflict", err)
	}

	ready, created, err := resolver.ReconcileReadiness(context.Background(), "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", input)
	if err != nil || !created || ready.Decision != domain.PracticeReadinessReady || ready.LearnerStateDigest == first.LearnerStateDigest {
		t.Fatalf("new reconciliation = (%+v, created=%v, err=%v), want READY for current mastery", ready, created, err)
	}
}

func TestReconcileReadinessRejectsWrongInstanceOrRevision(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1)
	}{
		{name: "instance", mutate: func(input *domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1) {
			input.TaskInstanceID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
		}},
		{name: "revision", mutate: func(input *domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1) {
			input.TaskRevisionID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
		}},
		{name: "digest", mutate: func(input *domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1) {
			input.TaskRevisionDigest = "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"
		}},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			routes := newRouteRepositoryStub()
			students := &practiceStudentStub{}
			resolver := testResolver(routes, &practiceCatalogStub{definitions: []domain.LearningTargetDefinition{
				{Ref: targetDOM, Title: "DOM", Description: "Events"}, {Ref: targetCSS, Title: "Grid", Description: "Layouts"},
			}}, students)
			resolver.Readiness = newReadinessRepositoryStub()
			base := validRouteRequest()
			route, _, err := resolver.Resolve(context.Background(), base.TaskInstanceID, base)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			input := readinessRouteRequest()
			input.RouteID, input.RouteDigest = route.ID, route.RouteDigest
			test.mutate(&input)
			_, _, err = resolver.ReconcileReadiness(context.Background(), "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", input)
			if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
				t.Fatalf("got %v, want route identity conflict", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func validRouteRequest() domain.PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1 {
	return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1{
		Schema:    domain.PracticeLearningRouteRequestSchemaV1,
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", TaskInstanceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		TaskRevisionID:     "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", Locale: "ru",
		Steps: []domain.PracticeLearningStepInput{{StepID: "board", Requirements: []domain.PracticeLearningRequirement{
			{ID: "dom", Target: targetDOM, Policy: domain.RequirementPolicyRequired, MasteryThreshold: .7},
			{ID: "grid-adaptive", Target: targetCSS, Policy: domain.RequirementPolicyAdaptive, MasteryThreshold: .5},
			{ID: "grid-recommended", Target: targetCSS, Policy: domain.RequirementPolicyRecommended, MasteryThreshold: .5},
		}}},
	}
}

type routeRepositoryStub struct {
	byTask map[string]domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord
	byID   map[string]domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord
}

type readinessRepositoryStub struct {
	records map[string]domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord
}

func newReadinessRepositoryStub() *readinessRepositoryStub {
	return &readinessRepositoryStub{records: map[string]domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}}
}

func readinessRecordKey(taskInstanceID, stepID, key string) string {
	return taskInstanceID + "\x00" + stepID + "\x00" + key
}

func (repository *readinessRepositoryStub) GetByIdempotencyKey(_ context.Context, taskInstanceID, stepID, key string) (domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord, error) {
	result, ok := repository.records[readinessRecordKey(taskInstanceID, stepID, key)]
	if !ok {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (repository *readinessRepositoryStub) EnsureReadiness(_ context.Context, record domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord) (domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord, bool, error) {
	key := readinessRecordKey(record.Receipt.TaskInstanceID, record.Receipt.StepID, record.IdempotencyKey)
	if existing, ok := repository.records[key]; ok {
		if existing.RequestHash != record.RequestHash {
			return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return existing, false, nil
	}
	repository.records[key] = record
	return record, true, nil
}

func newRouteRepositoryStub() *routeRepositoryStub {
	return &routeRepositoryStub{byTask: map[string]domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, byID: map[string]domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}}
}
func (repository *routeRepositoryStub) GetByTaskInstance(_ context.Context, id string) (domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord, error) {
	result, ok := repository.byTask[id]
	if !ok {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return result, nil
}
func (repository *routeRepositoryStub) GetByID(_ context.Context, id string) (domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord, error) {
	result, ok := repository.byID[id]
	if !ok {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return result, nil
}
func (repository *routeRepositoryStub) Ensure(_ context.Context, record domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord) (domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord, bool, error) {
	if existing, ok := repository.byTask[record.Route.TaskInstanceID]; ok {
		if existing.RequestHash != record.RequestHash {
			return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return existing, false, nil
	}
	repository.byTask[record.Route.TaskInstanceID] = record
	repository.byID[record.Route.ID] = record
	return record, true, nil
}

type practiceCatalogStub struct {
	definitions []domain.LearningTargetDefinition
}

func (stub *practiceCatalogStub) ResolveDefinitions(_ context.Context, requested []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.LearningTargetDefinition, error) {
	wanted := make(map[string]struct{}, len(requested))
	for _, target := range requested {
		wanted[domain.TargetIdentity(target)] = struct{}{}
	}
	result := make([]domain.LearningTargetDefinition, 0, len(requested))
	for _, definition := range stub.definitions {
		if _, exists := wanted[domain.TargetIdentity(definition.Ref)]; exists {
			result = append(result, definition)
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

type practiceStudentStub struct {
	mastery []domain.TargetMastery
	calls   int
}

func (stub *practiceStudentStub) QueryMastery(_ context.Context, _ string, targets []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.TargetMastery, error) {
	stub.calls++
	if len(stub.mastery) != 0 {
		return stub.mastery, nil
	}
	result := make([]domain.TargetMastery, len(targets))
	for index, target := range targets {
		result[index] = domain.TargetMastery{Target: target, State: domain.MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}
	}
	return result, nil
}

type practicePolicyStub struct{}

func (practicePolicyStub) GetActivePolicyBundle(context.Context) (domain.PolicyBundle, error) {
	return domain.PolicyBundle{
		PlannerVersion: domain.PlannerVersion, PedagogyProfile: domain.DefaultPedagogyProfile,
		PresentationStyle: domain.DefaultPresentationStyle, GenerationPolicy: domain.DefaultGenerationPolicy,
		MasterySkipConfidence: domain.DefaultMasteryConfidence,
		PedagogyStrategies: []domain.PedagogyStrategyVersion{
			{Code: "explicit_instruction", Version: 1, Priority: 10, Config: json.RawMessage(`{}`)},
			{Code: "retrieval_practice", Version: 1, Priority: 9, Config: json.RawMessage(`{}`)},
		},
	}, nil
}

type practiceClock struct{}

func (practiceClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }

func testResolver(routes *routeRepositoryStub, catalog *practiceCatalogStub, students *practiceStudentStub) Resolver {
	return Resolver{Routes: routes, Catalog: catalog, Students: students, Policies: practicePolicyStub{}, Strategies: pedagogy.NewDefaultRegistry(), Clock: practiceClock{}}
}

func readinessRouteRequest() domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1 {
	return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1{Schema: domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestSchemaV1,
		TaskInstanceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		TaskRevisionID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		RouteID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", RouteDigest: "sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc", StepID: "board"}
}
